details: For finite concept classes. The singleton family gives an unbounded gap: $\mathrm Q_{\mathrm{mpeq}}=n-1$ while $\mathrm Q_{\mathrm{meq}}=1$.
name: Membership and Proper Equivalence Queries Complexity / Membership and Equivalence Queries Complexity
proof: Replacing proper equivalence queries by unrestricted equivalence queries enlarges the learner's available query set.  Thus the mixed proper model cannot have smaller optimal complexity.
